cohort: The study included 42 pregnant women with a history of three consecutive failed embryo transfer/blastocyst transfer (ET/BT) cycles who conceived in a subsequent IVF-ET/BT cycle, and a control group of women who had a live birth in the first ET/BT attempt.
finding: Neither a history of repeated implantation failure (RIF) nor local endometrial injury (LEI) for RIF significantly increased the incidence of obstetric complications in women who conceived in a subsequent ET/BT cycle.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in the incidence of caesarean section between the RIF, RIF/LEI, and control groups.
